def transform(grid):
    """Mark each tile containing more than one non-background signal."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        if r0 == r1:
            continue
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if c0 == c1:
                continue
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            background = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
            signals = sum(v != background for v in vals)
            row.append(1 if signals > 1 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    """For each tile, emit 1 for exactly two marker cells; otherwise emit its background."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    result = []
    for i in range(len(rb) - 1):
        r0, r1 = rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]
        if r0 == r1:
            continue
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            c0, c1 = cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1]
            if c0 == c1:
                continue
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            background = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
            marker_count = sum(v != background for v in cells)
            out_row.append(1 if marker_count == 2 else background)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
